basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Non Teaching Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 6 Junior Assistant, Swimming Pool Maintenance Staff Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore) is recruiting candidates for 7 contract vacancies under advertisement number IITI/GAD/Outsourced/Rect./08. The posts include Junior Assistant, Swimming Pool Maintenance Staff, Junior Assistant (Dining Supervisor), and Junior Assistant (Hostel Supervisor). Candidates can apply through the offline application process, with the completed application reaching the designated office on or before 23 October 2026. faq.question: Q1. Is this job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is on a contract basis through an outsourcing agency for a period of 01 year, with extensions based on performance.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of advertisement and application is 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualifications are needed for the Junior Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline (or Graduate/Postgraduate in Commerce/MBA in Finance/CA Inter for the Finance post) along with specific required experience and computer operation knowledge.

faq.question: Q4. What are the monthly salaries for skilled and semi-skilled posts?
faq.answer: Skilled posts offer a consolidated remuneration of ₹29,432/- per month, while semi-skilled posts offer ₹25,718/- per month.
